critique: Both sampled frames are completely black: there is no visible burst, hot core, flame tongue, spark, or directional muzzle-flash silhouette. The 0.08s disappearance could be appropriate for a short flash, but the absence at 0.01s means the effect is not rendering visibly at all. The anomalous near-zero denormal Angle X value is the most likely invalid directional-control input.

suggestions.why: Replace the invalid denormalized Angle X value (6.3e-322) with a valid angle so the particle emission direction can render normally.
